item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: YES.

Elevator Pitch: Watch your back, cause apparently not every human “HUMAN”.

+ Dr.██████ Log
- Dr.██████ Log

Time: 15/10/2019, 4:46 AM

While the Site-71 night shift personnel’s worked in the offices, an intruder alert went off inside Site-71,

[ EMEMRGENCY PRODCAST TO ALL MOBIEL TASK FORCE PERSONNEL, INTRUDER OF UNKNOWN ORIGIN HAS BEEN DETECTED AT RESEARCH LABORATORY BETA, SOUTH WING OF THE FACILITY, THE INTRUDER IS TO BE CONTAINED FOR INTERROGATION AND / OR NEUTRALISED ONLY IF NECESSARY ]

in the meantime at the lab researchers were scared & confused about what just happened, a man in black tactical suite were fighting a unknown humanoid creature as they realized that this is not one of any SCP’s that they are already containing in this facility, the unknown soldier was heard asking the SCP to stop the destruction while referring the creature as SCP-XXXX, then SCP-XXXX gives the soldier a very strong punch that makes him halfway through the lab, then the soldier hideout while screamed at the researchers saying “ close your eyes, don’t look at his eyes “ and then he fainted, seconds later MTF arrived and apprehended the soldier, many interrogations & interviews were logged and saved & many were classified but basically the end result was that the soldier came from one of many copies of our universe / dimension or as he like to say ( Earth-16 ), the soldier also claimed that he is one of SCP-MTF: Alpha 1 team as well as claiming that SCP-XXXX is vulnerable to a quantum type of weaponry / items and he also claimed that he followed SCP-XXXX to our earth ( Earth-1 ) in order to contain SCP-XXXX once and for all, further research’s has been indicated, and the study’s showed a 3,496 year old drowning inside a cave in what now known as Dubai, United Arab Emirates describing that SCP-XXXX was actually last seen in our earth ( Earth-1 ) at least 6000 years ago and disappeared sometime between 4,500 and 3,496 years ago, that`s until now.

Central Narrative:

+ Dr.██████ Log
- Dr.██████ Log

Few months later, Time: 16/1/2020, 7:58 PM

Site-71 had investigated hundreds of reports of sudden violent and murder victim’s but unfortunately that was useless that’s until they had a call from Dubai police department indicate that they had a call from a man claiming that he’s been chased by a guy with skeleton mask and bluish green fire coming out of his head and a lizard type skin costume, Fortunately, the police operation officer that was talking to the man on the phone was one of SCP-MTF: Luta-10 and he immediately informed the Site-71 management about it, site-71 tracked the SCP-XXXX into a newly built area with no civilians living in there and found that the caller was possessed by SCP-XXXX so they started to neutralize the possessed man, SCP-XXXX rematerializes into his form but this time SCP-MTF Teams were ready they used [ project: Scramble ] and it showed a good results as it “scrambles” the face / eyes of SCP-XXXX and won’t let him possess the “scramble” user, MTF team’s started to fight against SCP-XXXX and had many casualties before he ran towards heavy populated area, immediately Site-71 was informed to evacuate the area to ensure that SCP-XXXX does not escape and be Contained, SCP-XXXX was surrounded by MTF team`s within 900.000 square meter area called “CITY WALK” in Dubai which then the MTF team continued to fight with SCP-XXXX, more 4 casualties accorded, backup been called to help with quantum rifles, Finley SCP-XXXX was weakened and captured & contained in a quantum based titanium container deep underground in site-71.

Hook/Attention-Grabber:

+ Dr.██████ Log
- Dr.██████ Log

Further study’s showed that SPC-XXXX was worshipped as a ( GOD ) yet he doesn’t possess a ( GOD ) like power but he still has the power to possess humans body and use it to do whatever he wants & in such action the possessed humans are considered dead in site duo to the fact that SCP-XXXX won’t let the body as long as the body can survive [ NOTHING CONFIRMED ].
When the possessed body dies SCP-XXXX rematerializes into his form and try to seek a new body, however the MTF soldier from ( Earth-16 ) stated that in [ Earth-16 ] researchers have discovered ancient texts indicating that even without a human body SCP-XXXX can change his size to at least 18 meters and that he possesses the strength equivalent to 100 men.

Additional Notes:
1- SCP-XXX status is [ CONTAINED ].
2- So far SCP-XXXX only react to quantum type of weaponry / items [ additional research is required ].
3- Special containment systems is required [ subject cell is to be daily checked and / or updated if necessary].
